exposure: Intra-caesarean implantation of the newly designed frameless Gyn-CS
cohort: 100 multiparous women undergoing planned or emergency caesarean section
finding: The study found that the intra-caesarean implantation of the newly designed frameless Gyn-CS to the uterine fundus is a simple procedure that has no timing restraints, high patient acceptance and minimal risk of expulsion and displacement, while affording all the contraceptive benefits of a conventional copper-releasing intrauterine device.
mod_finding: The study specifically investigated the use of the Gyn-CS device, which is inserted immediately after delivery of the placenta during caesarean section, and found it to have a low expulsion rate and high patient satisfaction.
